scripts.lint: ls-lint && biome check . && oxlint . && rumdl check .
scripts.build: for pkg in body-parser file-upload formidable static graphql redoc schemator swagger-ui passport; do bun build "packages/$pkg/$pkg.es.js" --outdir "packages/$pkg/cjs" --entry-naming "tmp.cjs.js" --format cjs --target node --packages=external --sourcemap=inline --define 'process.env.NANO_ENV_MODULE="commonjs"' && mv "packages/$pkg/cjs/tmp.cjs.js" "packages/$pkg/cjs/$pkg.cjs.js" || exit 1; done
scripts.release-me: export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"; for pkg in body-parser file-upload formidable static graphql redoc schemator swagger-ui passport; do (cd packages/$pkg && release-me --plugins=npm,npm-post,git,github-release) || exit 1; done
